description: This file provides a reference implementation of JSON parsing and stringifying functions, including a polyfill for the global JSON object with methods JSON.stringify and JSON.parse, and extends Date.prototype.toJSON for ISO date formatting.

methods.name: stringify
methods.description: Serializes a JavaScript value to a JSON string, with optional whitelist for selecting object members.

methods.name: parse
methods.description: Parses a JSON string into a JavaScript object or array, with optional filter function for transformation.
